list.title: Scan Directory List

empty.title: No Scan Directories
empty.description: Add scan directories to automatically manage your game library

deleteDialog.title: Confirm Delete
deleteDialog.description: Are you sure you want to delete the scan directory "{{path}}"? This action cannot be undone.

list.batchDeleteBody: Only the scanner configuration is removed; imported games are untouched.

notifications.intervalTooShort: Scan interval cannot be less than 5 minutes

globalSettings.preserveSavesTooltip: Back up saves before re-compressing (uses the Vnite save system, or auto-detects / mirrors in-folder saves) and restore them after the next extraction.
globalSettings.duplicatePriorityTooltip: When several archives hold the same game, keep the highest version; turn off to keep the best Chinese translation instead.
globalSettings.nameFromFolderTooltip: After scraping, use the game folder (or archive) name as the localized display name. The original name is untouched.
globalSettings.title: Global Scanner Settings
globalSettings.scanIntervalTooltip: Scan interval time for all scanners, in minutes
globalSettings.ignoreListPlaceholder: Enter folder names to exclude, supports regex
globalSettings.ignoreListTooltip: Supports regular expressions, each line is a separate expression
globalSettings.scanArchivesTooltip: Treat archives (zip/7z/rar incl. multi-volume) as games: index and scrape without extracting
globalSettings.aggregateSearchTooltip: Query several sources at once and merge results; priority bangumi > vndb > dlsite > ymgal > steam > igdb
globalSettings.extractRootPlaceholder: Leave empty to extract next to the archive
globalSettings.autoCompressTooltip: When a game is marked as finished, re-compress it and delete the extracted folder
globalSettings.externalToolPlaceholder: Path to Bandizip or WinRAR exe
globalSettings.externalToolTooltip: Once set, the archive panel can open the current archive with it (Bandizip / WinRAR / 7-Zip FM all work).
globalSettings.skipIncompleteTooltip: Skip archives that are still downloading, locked or missing volumes so no broken game entry is created. Re-check manually from the archive panel.
globalSettings.renameFolderToNameTooltip: After scraping, rename the game folder to the localized name returned by the provider and update the stored paths. Archive files are left untouched.
globalSettings.preferChineseNameTooltip: When the matched source has no Chinese title (e.g. only romaji), try Bangumi / Ymgal / VNDB and use their Chinese name. If nothing is found the name stays as-is.
globalSettings.archiveInFolderTooltip: When an archive game is scanned, create a folder named after the localized name next to the archive, move the archive inside, and extract into it so the extracted folder sits beside the archive.

failedFolders.title: Process Failed Folders
failedFolders.helpText: Please enter the game ID for the corresponding data source, e.g., Steam game's AppID

editScanner.depthTooltip: Set the depth level for folder scanning
editScanner.hierarchyLevelHelp: Default 0: the first-level subfolder under Path is treated as the game folder.
